items.label: IfcPipeSegment 'PL-301 compressed air DN25 segment 2' x 2 elements: 'CV-301 side rail south', 'CV-301 side rail north'
items.understanding: DN25 compressed air pipe PL-301 running north-south at z 0.70 m crosses the CV-301 conveyor side rails running east-west at z ~0.695 m. The 50 mm overlap blocks the pipe and the same pipe also hits the north rail, so one fix must lift or drop the pipe run clear of both rails.

option.title: Shift pipe west minimal
option.rationale: Minimum west shift to put pipe face clear of rail end, same route as above with tighter margin.
option.also_needs: 2 x 90 deg elbows at each end, verify 50 mm clearance to rail end

alternatives.title: Shift pipe west past rail ends
alternatives.rationale: Moves pipe centre from x -2.8 to -3.7, just west of rail west end at -3.6, clearing south and north rails in one move with margin.
alternatives.also_needs: 2 x 90 deg elbows at each end of the run to rejoin the main
